values.name: KE_GPU_COMPARE_UNDEFINED
values.doc: No comparison (default for samplers without shadow compare)

enums.name: ke_gpu_shader_language
enums.doc: Shader source language a device accepts. Query via `ke_gpu_device::shader_language`.

enums.name: ke_result_domain
enums.doc: The domains that own a range of result codes. A domain's own codes are written `KE_RESULT_CODE(KE_RESULT_DOMAIN_ <DOMAIN >, n)` in its header, with `n` from 1 up.

enums.name: ke_result
enums.doc: What a fallible call returns: `KE_OK`, or the code of the failure. The detail of a failure goes to the failing library's log, never into the code. A caller treats a code it does not know as `KE_RESULT_GENERAL`. Ignoring the result of a call is a compiler warning where the compiler supports it.

enums.name: ke_render_binding_hint_flags
enums.doc: What a pass states about a shader binding that the shader's reflection does not carry.

values.name: KE_RENDER_BINDING_HINT_DEPTH
values.doc: The texture is bound to a depth-format view.

values.name: KE_RENDER_BINDING_HINT_DYNAMIC_OFFSET
values.doc: The buffer is bound with a dynamic offset given when its set is bound.

fields.name: z_zero_to_one
fields.doc: True when clip z is in [0,1] (Vulkan/D3D/WebGPU), false for [-1,1] (GL).

fields.name: y_flip
fields.doc: True when a top-left framebuffer origin needs a Y flip in projection.

fields.name: copy_bytes_per_row_alignment
fields.doc: Byte multiple a texture/buffer copy's bytes_per_row must be a multiple of; 1 when the backend imposes none.

fields.name: label

fields.name: initial_data_size

structs.name: ke_gpu_command_buffer
structs.doc: Recorded commands, submitted with ke_gpu_device::queue_submit and released by their handle.

structs.name: ke_render_binding_hint
structs.doc: A hint for the binding a shader declares under `name`.

structs.name: ke_render_shader_binding
structs.doc: What one named parameter of a shader is bound to; only the field its type reads is used.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The parameter's name; the uniform data of a block is named after the block.

structs.name: ke_render_shader_layout_params
structs.doc: The compiled shader a layout is built for.

fields.name: shader
fields.doc: Logical name the shader was compiled under, as a render service's load_shader takes it.

fields.name: stages
fields.doc: Bitwise OR of the KE_GPU_SHADER_STAGE_* stages the shader is compiled for.

structs.name: ke_render_material_data
structs.doc: The data of one material, as the `mat` parameter block of a material shader reads it.

fields.name: base_color
fields.doc: Linear RGBA.

fields.name: alpha_cutoff
fields.doc: The discard threshold; 0 draws every fragment.

vtables.name: ke_gpu_command_encoder_handle
vtables.doc: Owns a command encoder: destroy releases it, whether or not it was finished.

vtables.name: ke_gpu_command_buffer_handle
vtables.doc: Owns a finished command buffer: destroy releases it, after it was submitted or instead.

slots.name: queue_submit
slots.doc: Submits the command buffers to the queue, in order.

slots.name: queue_poll
slots.doc: Runs this device's event pump without blocking: delivers the callbacks of work that has completed since the last pump (create_render_pipeline_async, map_buffer_read).

slots.name: create_buffer
slots.doc: Creates a buffer. The backend's reason for a rejection is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_buffer
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: create_texture
slots.doc: Creates a texture. The backend's reason for a rejection is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_texture
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: create_texture_view
slots.doc: Creates a view of `tex`. The backend's reason for a rejection is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_view
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: create_sampler
slots.doc: Creates a sampler. The backend's reason for a rejection is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_sampler
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: create_shader_module
slots.doc: Creates a shader module. The backend's reason for rejecting the source is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_module
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: create_render_pipeline
slots.doc: Creates a render pipeline. The backend's reason for a rejection is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a color target without a format, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_pipeline
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: create_compute_pipeline
slots.doc: Creates a compute pipeline. The backend's reason for a rejection is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_pipeline
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: create_bind_group_layout
slots.doc: Creates a bind group layout. The backend's reason for a rejection is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_layout
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: create_bind_group
slots.doc: Creates a bind group. The backend's reason for a rejection is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_group
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: destroy_pipeline
slots.doc: Releases a pipeline made by create_render_pipeline or create_render_pipeline_async.

slots.name: create_command_encoder
slots.doc: Creates a command encoder. p may be NULL, which creates it unlabeled.

params.name: out_encoder
params.doc: Receives the encoder; left zeroed on failure.

slots.name: query_extension
slots.doc: Returns a typed extension vtable by name, or NULL if unsupported.

slots.name: shader_language
slots.doc: Shader source language this device accepts in create_shader_module.

slots.name: get_ndc_convention
slots.doc: Clip-space convention this backend expects projections built in.

slots.name: create_render_pipeline_async
slots.doc: Kicks a background pipeline compile — the driver compiles off the caller's thread; `on_ready` fires later (during this device's normal event pump, e.g. at queue_poll) with the finished pipeline, or KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure. No caching and no fallback.

slots.name: flush_pipeline_compiles
slots.doc: Blocks until every pipeline compile kicked via create_render_pipeline_async has invoked its on_ready callback. Call before destroying anything an in-flight callback might still write into. A no-op if nothing is pending.

slots.name: map_buffer_read
slots.doc: Starts mapping [offset, offset + size) of a buffer created with KE_GPU_BUFFER_USAGE_MAP_READ for reading. `on_ready` fires later, during this device's normal event pump (queue_poll, queue_wait_idle), with `ok` true when the range is readable through map_buffer until unmap_buffer, and false when the mapping failed. Submit the work that writes the buffer before calling.

slots.name: destroy_compute_pipeline
slots.doc: Releases a pipeline made by create_compute_pipeline.

slots.name: push_debug_group
slots.doc: Opens a named group that capture tools nest the following commands under, until the matching pop_debug_group. The label is copied by the call.

slots.name: pop_debug_group
slots.doc: Closes the group the last unmatched push_debug_group opened.

slots.name: insert_debug_marker
slots.doc: Marks a single named point in the command stream. The label is copied by the call.

slots.name: push_debug_group
slots.doc: Opens a named group that capture tools nest the following commands under, until the matching pop_debug_group. The label is copied by the call.

slots.name: pop_debug_group
slots.doc: Closes the group the last unmatched push_debug_group opened.

slots.name: insert_debug_marker
slots.doc: Marks a single named point in the command stream. The label is copied by the call.

slots.name: begin_compute_pass
slots.doc: Begins a compute pass. p may be NULL, which begins it unlabeled.

slots.name: copy_buffer_to_texture
slots.doc: Copies tightly described rows of texels from a buffer into a texture. Fails with KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT when bytes_per_row is not a multiple of ke_gpu_capabilities::copy_bytes_per_row_alignment.

slots.name: finish
slots.doc: Ends recording and returns the commands as a buffer to submit. The encoder records nothing more and is still released by its own handle.

params.name: out_buffer
params.doc: Receives the command buffer; left zeroed on failure.

slots.name: copy_texture_to_buffer
slots.doc: Copies a texture region into a buffer created with KE_GPU_BUFFER_USAGE_COPY_DST; the texture needs KE_GPU_TEXTURE_USAGE_COPY_SRC. Fails with KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT when bytes_per_row is not a multiple of ke_gpu_capabilities::copy_bytes_per_row_alignment.

slots.name: push_debug_group
slots.doc: Opens a named group that capture tools nest the following commands under, until the matching pop_debug_group. The label is copied by the call.

slots.name: pop_debug_group
slots.doc: Closes the group the last unmatched push_debug_group opened.

slots.name: insert_debug_marker
slots.doc: Marks a single named point in the command stream. The label is copied by the call.

vtables.name: ke_gpu_render_target
vtables.doc: The surface a frame is drawn into. A frame is one acquire followed, once the frame's command buffers were submitted, by one present.

slots.name: acquire
slots.doc: Begins a frame and writes the view to draw into, owned by the target and valid until present. Succeeds writing KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE when the target has nothing to draw into this frame, and fails writing it when acquiring failed.

params.name: out_view
params.doc: Receives the view.

slots.name: present
slots.doc: Ends the frame begun by acquire. Fails with KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT when no frame is acquired.

slots.name: size
slots.doc: Size in pixels of the view the last acquire returned, or of the next one before any acquire.

slots.name: format
slots.doc: Texel format of every view acquire returns.

vtables.name: ke_render_resource_binder
vtables.doc: Brings the resources of a frame to the shaders that read them. A pass names a shader's parameters and never learns how they reach it: in groups, in tables indexed per draw, or any other way the implementation chooses.

slots.name: provide
slots.doc: Makes `binding` the resource of every shader parameter of its name that a resource set leaves out. The name is copied.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT when the binding has no name, or KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY when it cannot be kept.

slots.name: create_shader_layout
slots.doc: Builds the layout of a compiled shader from what the build recorded about it.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND when the shader's record is missing, or KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT when it cannot be read or a hint names no parameter of the shader, the reason logged.

params.name: out_layout
params.doc: Receives the layout; KE_RENDER_BINDING_INVALID on failure.

slots.name: destroy_shader_layout
slots.doc: Destroys a layout; the invalid one is ignored. A set created against it must be destroyed first.

slots.name: pipeline_layouts
slots.doc: Fills the bind group layouts a pipeline running the shader of `layout` declares.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT when the layout is unknown or the shader needs more than `capacity` layouts.

params.name: out_layouts
params.doc: Receives the layouts in the order the pipeline takes them; they stay owned by the binder and live as long as `layout`.

params.name: capacity
params.doc: The number of entries `out_layouts` holds.

params.name: out_count
params.doc: Receives the number of layouts written.

slots.name: create_set
slots.doc: Binds resources to one group of a shader by the names its parameters carry. A parameter left out is bound to what `provide` gave under its name.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND when the shader declares no such block, or KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT when a binding names no parameter of the group, a parameter is bound twice or a parameter has no resource, the reason logged.

params.name: block
params.doc: Name of a parameter block the shader declares; NULL selects its parameters declared outside any block.

params.name: label
params.doc: Name shown by capture and validation tools.

params.name: bindings
params.doc: The resources bound, each to the parameter it names.

params.name: out_set
params.doc: Receives the set; KE_RENDER_BINDING_INVALID on failure.

slots.name: destroy_set
slots.doc: Destroys a set; the invalid one is ignored.

slots.name: bind_render_set
slots.doc: Makes the resources of `set` those the next draws of `pass` read, with one dynamic offset per binding hinted KE_RENDER_BINDING_HINT_DYNAMIC_OFFSET, in the order the shader declares them.

slots.name: bind_compute_set
slots.doc: Makes the resources of `set` those the next dispatches of `pass` read, as bind_render_set does.

slots.name: create_material
slots.doc: Keeps the data of one material for the shaders that draw with it. The texture views are borrowed and must outlive the binding.

params.name: out_material
params.doc: Receives the binding; KE_RENDER_BINDING_INVALID on failure.

slots.name: destroy_material
slots.doc: Destroys a material binding; the invalid one is ignored.

slots.name: bind_material
slots.doc: Makes `material` the one the next draws of `pass` with the shader of `layout` read. An unknown material or a shader that declares no material binds nothing.

callbacks.name: ke_gpu_pipeline_ready_func
callbacks.doc: Receives a pipeline compiled asynchronously, KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

callbacks.name: ke_gpu_buffer_mapped_func
callbacks.doc: Receives the outcome of mapping a buffer for reading.

constants.name: KE_RENDER_BINDING_INVALID
constants.doc: The value no shader layout, resource set or material binding takes.
